description: A mac-vrf whose anycast gateway declares IPv6, against a fabric qualification record that does not show the IPv6 anycast gateway as qualified (mac-vrf.anycast-gateway-ipv6 unqualified, everything else qualified): refused at interpretation naming the unqualified property; the allocator stage is never reached and no claim is made (CR-010, FR-097, AD-58). Against a record that does qualify it, the same interpretation is accepted: VLAN 130 is named (no VLAN claim), one L2VNI and one L3VNI are claimed, and both declared families are carried.
request_text: a mac-vrf for tenant acme on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 and leaf02 ethernet-1/1 vlan 130 with anycast gateway 10.30.0.1/24 and 2001:db8:30::1/64

cause_contains: anycast_gateway.ipv6: the IPv6 anycast gateway is not shown as qualified

negative_control.description: the same interpretation against a record that shows mac-vrf.anycast-gateway-ipv6 qualified
